title: FrameRefusal
description: A frame refused, given to its readers in its place: by its transport, for its first fault as BusFrame, or by its channel's typed read, for its payload's first fault as its channel's (contract/TRANSPORT-CONTRACT.md § Frames). A transport's own, never on the wire.

member.description: The way from the frame to its first fault; a fault of its payload is within `payload`.

payload.$comment: The frame's payload as it came, the gateway's stamps and all; absent when the frame carried none: JSON, as it is given.

scope.description: The resource whose scope it was delivered on; absent when it names none.

correlationId.description: The frame's correlation id, when it carries one BusFrame allows: a request awaiting the reply it names is told of the refusal at once.
